title: DC Bouldering Project
gap: Exact prices for day passes, memberships, and punch passes not stated
blurb: DC Bouldering Project in Eckington offers a 34,000+ sq ft facility with world-class bouldering walls including a 55-foot overhang called The Beast. The gym provides climbing, fitness, yoga, and youth classes, as well as amenities like saunas and coworking spaces. Day passes include rental climbing shoes and a facility orientation for first-time visitors.
